recognize_zh: 白血球極度增多的抹片中，大量中大型細胞的核呈雙葉、蝴蝶狀或腎形折疊，細胞質淡藍灰、幾乎看不到明顯顆粒，這種「雙葉核＋少顆粒」的外觀是微顆粒型 APL（M3v）的線索。
features: Marked leukocytosis with numerous medium-to-large abnormal cells
Characteristic bilobed, butterfly or reniform folded nuclei
Fine chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with few or no visible azurophilic granules
Occasional faint cytoplasmic granularity in rare cells; Auer rods not evident in this field
Background red cells without obvious schistocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked hyperleukocytosis composed predominantly of medium-to-large abnormal cells. The cells have characteristically bilobed or butterfly-shaped, folded nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale gray-blue cytoplasm that appears hypogranular to agranular by light microscopy. No Auer rod bundles are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; strong MPO positivity, CD34-/HLA-DR- immunophenotype, and PML::RARA testing are needed, and coagulopathy should be anticipated.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei too, but are usually NSE-positive, weakly MPO-positive, and HLA-DR positive, whereas M3v cells are strongly MPO-positive and HLA-DR negative.
Classic APL shows abundant coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, while this field shows hypogranular cytoplasm with bilobed nuclei.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of lymphoma with cleaved nuclei (e.g., mantle cell, Sezary)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have coarser chromatin and lack MPO, and flow cytometry shows mature B- or T-cell phenotype.
